title: Announcing Our New Corporate Brand! | HatchWorks AI
description: As we approach our first decade of tremendous accomplishments, we have a lot to be thankful for, and a lot to celebrate. It's for this reason that we embarked on creating and launching our new brand—one that now better showcases our fantastic culture, and promotes our award-winning expertise in Enterprise Software Services.
